Anya: T-8 days to GA. Need a 1-page signoff checklist: SLA numbers, docs freeze + migration notes, support rota, monitoring alerts, pricing tiers. Quick owners?
Rae: Ops will take monitoring + oncall rota. Plan: 72h elevated coverage post-GA, dashboards p50/p95/p99, alerts p99>600ms, errors>1% 5m.
Diego: I'll own SLA/perf. Propose Hosted 99.9% uptime p99 soft<=320ms hard<=600ms; Dedicated 99.95% p99 soft<=270ms hard<=450ms. Will run perf Wed.
Kat: Docs: I'll freeze API Fri EOD. Deliverables: quickstart <5min, API delta, migration table, incident contact cards.
Sam: Pricing: I'll draft GA tiering (Dev/Standard/Enterprise) + burst credits. Need Diego's cost numbers to finalize.
Ryan: Legal will draft SLA appendix + pilot SOW. Product: flag private-preview features to exclude.
Anya: Action owners recap: SLA=Diego, Docs=Kat, Monitoring=Rae, Pricing=Sam, Legal=Ryan. I'll open the GH signoff issue and ping owners.
Diego: If perf misses soft target, request temporary burst capacity and a 48h soft-gate for tuning.
Kat: Will include runbook links and a short "how to rollback" section in the quickstart.
Rae: Ops will add cross-region failover steps to dashboards and a cost-anomaly alert (token delta >25%).
Sam: Draft pricing by Thu pending Diego's numbers. Enterprise gets committed invoicing for GA.
Ryan: Sharing SLA draft Wed; need final numbers and excluded-features list.
ci-bot: Staging deploy (sha 5e7f9a) succeeded.
Anya: Final triage Thurs 11am PT. Please update GH checklist with evidence links as you finish items. :white_check_mark:
